questions.prompt: What made Chips easy to hear from far away?
questions.evidenceText: Chips had a blue bell on his collar. JINGLE! JINGLE! JINGLE! You could hear him coming from far away!

questions.prompt: What happened after Chips ran at the rose bush?
questions.evidenceText: Then Chips saw a big rose bush. He ran at it. CRUNCH! MUNCH! SNAP! The rose bush was gone.

questions.prompt: Why did James and Anna still smile at Chips?
questions.evidenceText: "CHIPS!" they both said. But they could not stop smiling. Chips was naughty and cheeky and silly — and they loved him so much.
